# https://mdelectricnc.com - llms.txt

## Site Purpose
Marcus Dyess Electric LLC is a licensed and insured electrical contractor based in Lenoir, North Carolina. The company wires custom homes for builders and also serves residential and commercial clients across the Catawba Valley, including Granite Falls, Hickory, Taylorsville, Morganton, Hudson, and Maiden.

## Services
- Custom home electrical and new construction wiring
- Interior custom lighting
- Panel upgrades
- Troubleshooting
- Dock wiring

## About
Marcus Dyess has more than 30 years of experience as an electrician and leads a growing crew. The business is licensed and insured.
